tooltip.documents:
Enable/disable the display of detailed evidence extracted from the original documents.
When activated, the system provides full reference sources, helping users easily verify accuracy. This feature can be combined with images or charts to create a more comprehensive and visual report.
tooltip.images:
Enable/disable the display of images and charts extracted or automatically generated from the data.
This feature helps visualize information, making it easier to understand compared to plain text. When combined with the document evidence feature, the system can generate detailed reports illustrated with both text and images.
tooltip.multiLanguage:
Enable/disable multi-language retrieval and analysis mode (English/Vietnamese).
When enabled, the system expands the search scope and integrates contextual analysis, intent prediction, and best-fit data mapping across both languages. It can be combined with the Tabular Data feature to improve answer accuracy.
tooltip.deepQuery:
Enable/disable deep query mode into the metadata database.
This function allows the AI to retrieve more detailed, complete, and accurate information compared to normal queries.
Best practice recommendation: enable Tabular Data first, perform the main query, and then combine multi-language mode for follow-up queries to optimize results.
tooltip.thinking:
Enable/disable advanced reasoning mode.
When activated, the AI applies multiple hidden reasoning steps, including context analysis, question summarization, goal prediction, and optimization of data retrieval before providing the final answer.
